The description of the different Egyptian Kingdoms could be shortened, perhaps focusing on the Old Kingdom, where the Great Pyramids were built, and the New Kingdom, which included Tutankhamun and Cleopatra.
The credit scene could be shortened by increasing the speed at which images cycle.
